assessment: No mathematical, source-lifetime or selected-branch blocker found for the authorized reciprocal mechanism/body cache integration at the frozen source hashes. It intentionally changes mechanical floating-point rounding; numerical tests and explicit OFF remain required evidence. No audibility, universal passivity, SDK or realtime claim.
review_mode: Read-only source/receipt review, independent small signed-impulse algebra checks, compile-only operand type assertions and reanalysis of existing arrays. No core edits, audio synthesis reruns, extra timing trials, guard retuning or calibration changes.

source_scope.later_profile_selector_plumbing: The cache matrices precede SelectedModel wrapper changes. Historical snapshots are intentionally reviewed; later default-selector equivalence is a separate integration. No requirement that the live FullInstrument.cpp still has this historical hash.

source_findings.render_reset_event_sidechannel: No allocation, lock, I/O, exception or RTTI introduced by cache stage. Private prepare may allocate; existing ordinary/nothrow C++ traps and strict compile flags verified. Direct malloc/aligned APIs are not comprehensively intercepted.

numeric_interpretation.exact_real_equivalence: Sequential v←v+G[:,g]J with G=B^T B retains cross-port feedback and telescopes all four body work terms to ideal board kinetic energy change.
mechanical_changes_include: One float board write replaces per-source float writes.
Projected Gram feedback omits intermediate float perturbations.
Precomputed double port/w and observer coefficients reassociate double multiplication/division.
Port impulse accumulation and observer reductions change double operation order.
numeric_interpretation.no_float_coefficient_product_bug: Compile-only assertions in frozen, default and alternate prepared models show w,sigma,port,mic are double; float q/p promote in original acceleration expressions. No DSP cast change made.
numeric_interpretation.local_energy_perturbation: For uActual=uIdeal+e, ΔEround=uIdeal·e+.5||e||², |ΔEround|≤||uIdeal||||e||+.5||e||². This is local and depends on actual e; it is not a whole-network bound.
numeric_interpretation.source_impulse_rounding_and_observer_rou: Actual Δp accounts for final float quantization. Precomputed/reassociated observer arithmetic still has its own double roundoff; algebraic identity is not bit-exact implementation identity.
numeric_interpretation.observer_contract_normalization: Original cache-contract maxScaled uses max(1,|delta|,|after|,|before|). For sub-unit signals it is an absolute model-sample scale, not signal-relative error. Recorded max absolute residual3.1974e-14 and max scaled1.4234e-15 have distinct meanings.
numeric_interpretation.geometry_and_units: Energy/work are nominal authored mass-normalized model units; return depth is an action proxy. Audio dB reference1 is float sample magnitude1, not Pa or SPL.

frozen_study_reanalysis.continuous_error_scope: Measured depth/recovery deltas and unchanged sampled admissions do not establish a-priori propagation or universal admission identity.

long_tail.scope: One4s48k C4 case,mechanicalLevel.2,independent double-promoted energy scans every256frames after last external event at0.08s.
long_tail.scan_limit: Every256frame scan can miss intervening maxima; not a universal passivity proof.

material_limits: No exact-double or exact-float mechanical/observer identity claim.
No universal bound on nonlinear trajectories, all possible strike admissions or audibility.
Snapshot assertions cover seven discrete controller fields and public admission diagnostics, not all internal controller state.
Full Reason two-setting matrix used first header form; generic version had rebuild+active smoke, while canonical generic version had full matrix+sanitizers.
No actual Jukebox SDK/compiler, Reason host, package or realtime deadline qualification.
No new precision, calibration, mode-count or mechanism-removal change authorized by this review.
